description: OLE-TXN visibility and locking across processes: A BeginTrans, UPDATEs row 1 and INSERTs a row without committing; B reads all rows, UPDATEs row 1 and then row 3 (Errors) and reads again; A RollbackTrans and B reads; A BeginTrans, UPDATEs row 1 and CommitTrans and B reads. Asks what an uncommitted transaction shows to another process, which statements are refused and the state after rollback and commit.
